verdict.rationale: The pack only vaguely gestures at CI/CD ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') and review assignment to Copilot, but never documents branch protection rules, required reviewers, environments with required approvals, or other explicit gating mechanisms that would enforce approval before production deploys. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of required-reviewer/branch-protection rules, deployment environment approval gates, CODEOWNERS enforcement, and any independent corroboration that these gates work as an approval workflow.
